Wait for the dashboard after the preflight

When the Commander sends a message to Celeste
Wait for the request reaching the LLM
Then the instructions say 'Current game state is:' only once
And the heading is alone on its line above the game state
And the fuel sentence ends with a period
And no sentence runs into the next one
